title: Journey A, current state: find what a Class B device importer needs (licences, route, fees, documents)
task: Starting from HSA's Medical devices page, with the device already classified as Class B, find (1) which dealer's licences are needed, (2) which registration route applies and its fee and turnaround, (3) the documents to prepare, and (4) how to get access to SHARE.
assumptions: Best case: the user follows HSA's own links and calls to action in the order a first-time reader would, and never gets lost beyond the two dead ends HSA's links lead to.
The user tries each link that promises a requirements checker once, then falls back to reading the pages.
Scrolling and re-reading are not modelled, so operator time is a lower bound. Opening a collapsed section is one P B B.
Risk classification is excluded from both current and redesigned journeys because both send the user to the same HSA tool.
Dead-end tabs are closed with Ctrl+W (H, K, K, H).

steps.action: Open HSA Medical devices page (from a search result)
Choose 'Regulatory overview'
Follow 'evaluation routes' to the Registration overview
Click 'Check device's route' (opens google.com in a new tab)
Realise it is the wrong site; close the tab
Follow 'Registration and licensing tools' under Useful links
Click 'Registration and licensing requirements' (opens a 404 page in a new tab)
Close the 404 tab and go back to the Registration overview
steps.ops: M H K K H P B B

steps.action: Open the 'Registration requirements' section and work out the route from the evaluation-route table
steps.decision: Which evaluation route applies (Full / Abridged / Expedited / Immediate)?

steps.action: Follow 'See registration guides'
Choose 'Register Class B medical device via immediate route'
Check each IBR Condition 1 criterion against the device
steps.decision: Does the device meet every immediate-route condition (approval, 3 years marketed, no safety issue, no rejection)?

steps.action: Note the documents list
steps.decision: Which documents apply to this route?

steps.action: Follow 'medical device fees and turn-around-time'
Open the 'Product registration' section, find the application fee and the Class B immediate-route fee and add them
steps.decision: What will registration cost and how long will it take?

steps.action: Use the breadcrumb to return to Medical devices
Choose 'Manufacturing, import and supply'
Choose 'Importer, wholesaler and manufacturers' licensing'
Choose 'Apply for a medical device dealer's licence'
Read licence types and decide which licences apply
Open the Importer's and Wholesaler's document sections
steps.ops: P B B P B B

steps.action: Decide which QMS evidence to submit
steps.decision: Which QMS certificate is acceptable for Class B?

steps.action: Go back and open the QMS page to confirm Class B needs certification
steps.ops: M P B B P B B R:S15

steps.action: Confirm certification requirement for Class B importers/wholesalers
steps.decision: Is a declaration enough, or is SAC-accredited certification needed?

steps.action: Return to the fees page for the licence fee
steps.ops: M P B B P B B R:S11

steps.action: Open the licence section, find the dealer's licence fee and multiply by the number of licences
Go back to the licence page and follow 'Guide to new application...' (lands on the SHARE e-service page)
steps.ops: M P B B P B B R:S16

steps.action: Look for access requirements
steps.decision: What account or access is needed to apply?

steps.action: Navigate Medical devices > Regulatory overview > 'Quick Guide' PDF for the Corppass and SHARE steps
